title: An owner links their FlowWeb business to a Frequency Space on flowweb.app, and Frequency's signed funnel events reach it
description: Step 2 of the Frequency plugin plan (https://claude.ai/artifact/5qXS1QLbKJVEdmf1w5suyi), the routes on top of migration 0009. A new Vercel Function api/plugin.mjs serves /v1/plugin, sent there by a vercel.json rewrite placed ahead of /v1 so api/v1.mjs is untouched. A signed-in owner or admin lists, makes, pauses, revokes and rotates the business's Frequency link with their own Supabase token; the secret comes back once. Frequency's server posts funnel events to /v1/plugin/links/{id}/events with the contract's headers; the route checks the headers and the event shape with frequency-link.mjs, then hands the raw body to fw_plugin_ingest, which checks the signature inside the database, so the site holds no service key. Refusals carry the contract's reasons with 401, 403 or 400. The handoff route and the console panels are later rows.
acceptance: vercel.json sends /v1/plugin/* to api/plugin.mjs ahead of the /v1 rewrite
An owner links their business and gets the secret once; a helper gets 403 and no sign-in gets 401
Listing links never shows a secret
A correctly signed event answers 202 and the business's machine can take it
Unsigned, wrong-link, stale, tampered, malformed, wrong-Space and paused events are refused with their reason
Rotating through the site retires the old secret
